    methods
        function obj = ControlledTerm(instanceSpec, name, value)
            % Accept any name-value pairs, as openminds.Node does, so that a
            % subclass can forward properties this class does not declare.
            % instanceSpec is not validated here because a controlled term
            % accepts a name, a file path or a struct, unlike a Node.
            arguments
                instanceSpec = []
            end
            arguments (Repeating)
                name (1,1) string
                value
            end

            propValues = struct();
            for i = 1:numel(name)
                propValues.(name{i}) = value{i};
            end

            obj = obj.initializeControlledTerm(instanceSpec, propValues);
        end
    end
